svg.title: Repeated city architecture under four seasonal conditions
svg.desc: The same five buildings and two roadside trees appear across four seasons. Winter has bare branches, snow and a bundled resident; spring has buds, blossoms and puddles; summer has full foliage, sunlight and cooling equipment; autumn has thinning leaves and a coated resident. These are contextual demand influences, not deterministic forecasts.

g.text: The same city changes season; demand also reflects people and weather

g.aria-label: Winter: bare trees, rooftop snow and a cold pale sky
Spring: fresh grass, buds, blossoms and rain puddles
Summer: full canopies, sunshine and cooling equipment
Autumn: thinning foliage, fallen leaves and overcast sky

g.text: Calendar cycles are known in advance. Realized future temperatures and shocks are not automatically available.
